question:
What is the value of the following expression?

\[ \begin{aligned} &1990 - 1980 + 1970 - 1960 \\ &\quad {}+ \cdots - 20 + 10 \end{aligned} \]
solution:
Neighboring differences such as \(1990-1980\) and \(1970-1960\) each equal \(10\), so grouping these pairs simplifies the calculation:
\[
(1990-1980)+(1970-1960)+\cdots+(30-20)+10.
\]
There are \(1990\div10=199\) terms, one for each multiple of \(10\) from \(10\) through \(1990\), with alternating signs. The first \(198\) terms form \(99\) separate pairs, leaving the final \(+10\) unpaired. Every term is included exactly once. Since each pair contributes \(10\), the expression equals
\[
99\cdot10+10=1000.
\]
The value is \(1000\), choice D.
